confidence_notes: Sequential actuation and standing-start clutch behavior were directly tested. Automatic cut and blip appeared present but were not telemetry-measured, so the promoted record marks the combined simulator behavior medium-confidence.
historical_notes: FIA GT2-005 documents the original manual Borg-Warner T56. A first-person Carsport Holland account documents a privateer Holinger sequential conversion. Approval applies to the AMS2 representation and must not be generalized to every historical Viper GTS-R.
